question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Imitate someone’s action or words in order to entertain or ridicule
solution:
The correct answer is **"Mimic"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Copy- **to produce something so that it is the same as an original piece of work

 
 
• **Example- **They've copied the basic design from the Japanese model and added a few of their own refinements.
 
 
 
• **Mimic- **to copy the way in which a particular person usually speaks and moves, usually in order to make people laugh
 
 
• **Example- **She was mimicking the various people in our office.
 
 
 
• **Repeat- **to say or tell people something more than once.
 
 
• **Example- **Would you mind repeating what you just said?
 
 
 
• **Duplicate- **to make an exact copy of something
 
 
• **Example-**The documents had been duplicated.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is** Option 2 i.e. Mimic.**
